title: Nashville Charmer
description:
Wake up in this adorable cottage.  Charming and modern, you will fall in love with this sweet house.  Spacious, comfortable  bedrooms with custom built-ins.   The kitchen and bath have been beautifully updated and are incredibly functional.  Nestled in a quiet neighborhood that is close to the Nashville Farmers Market and the famous Broadway sights.    You will have a hard time deciding if you should go out or stay in.  Either way this home is a perfect get away when you visit Music City.

The space
This lovely home has a 3 lovely bedrooms. One Queen, one full and one twin bed. Full bathroom with shower/bathtub and amenities.   The kitchen is beautifully appointed with all you need during your stay.   You can relax in the living room while watching T.V. on a big screen.  The backyard is not accessible for guest use.

Guest access
There is no back yard access for this home.

Other things to note
The backyard is not available for guest use.  This property is no smoking of any kind and no pets.
